headline: EPS falls sequentially but rises year-over-year
summary_short: Ajinomoto reported Q2 FY2026 basic EPS of ¥38.11, down 18.1% q/q but up 16.8% y/y.
summary_long: Basic EPS of ¥38.11 fell 18.1% sequentially from ¥46.54 but rose 16.8% year-over-year from ¥32.62. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary from verified shard data.
